confidentUnsupported.evidence: the issue appears to lie with the start control side of the system

blockingLoop.evidence: Customer said 'it starts and washes ok' three times, yet assistant still asked 'Was a delay start set or the programme not selected'

rationale: The assistant ran a 'dishwasher won't start' script and never engaged with the actual complaint of a door dropping with no resistance, despite the customer repeating it in every message, reporting a twang, and even describing a loose spring hanging on the right side. It concluded with a baseless 'start control' diagnosis that contradicts the customer's repeated statement that the machine starts and washes fine. No unsafe instructions were given and no part was pushed, but the homeowner was handed to an engineer with wrong context and no mention of the obvious broken hinge spring/cable, full model number, or hinge check.
